_comment: Parameter database for Sony SCENE files. status: confirmed = proven by file diff and/or manual+page; likely = strong indication; hypothesis = guess, verify on camera. Sources: community articles and the FS7 / FS7 II manuals (menu option lists, value ranges, 'saved in files' table).

00006.name: Preset Matrix
00006.evidence: Index = order of the manual's Preset Select list. Verified: Minus-G1 (FL Light) = 2, Filmlike (Cinema) = 3. BT.2020 only with 4K/QFHD rec format. FS7 Mk1 manual lists only 5 presets (Standard..F55 709 Like): BT.2020 exists only on FS7M2. sample set A Mk1: F55 709 Like = 4 confirmed on FS7 Mk1. sample set C FS7II ABNORM/ABHIGHLIGHT: first field 0 with preset 4 stored -> 0 = Preset Matrix Off (consistent with 1 = On) FS7M2 round 10 (2026-10-09): Preset Matrix Off + Preset Select F55 709 Like changes only this value '1,0' -> '0,4' (first field On/Off, second field the preset); with Off the preset select is not selectable on the camera.

00007.name: User Matrix
00007.evidence: Neutral R-G +10 -> 3293, R-B +8 -> 2635; Vibrant Level +23 -> 7574, Phase -5 -> -1647. Raw = menu step * ~329.3 (manual range -99..+99). Unit = 32768/99.5 = 329.327; camera values deviate by at most 1 raw unit from step*unit. sample set A Mk1 files: Level +15 -> 4940, -20 -> -6586 (phase and the rest 0). sample set C FS7II files: R-G +99 is stored as 32767 (not 99*329.33=32603) -> raw is capped at +-32767 (negative end assumed symmetric) FS7M2 round 9 (2026-10-09): Level -8 -> +8, Phase +5, R-G -5, R-B +10, G-R -10, G-B -3, B-R +3, B-G -7 give '1,2635,1647,-1647,3293,-3293,-988,988,-2305' (field order Level, Phase, R-G, R-B, G-R, G-B, B-R, B-G, scale 329.33 per step), Preset Cinema (3) -> Standard (0).

00074.name: Multi Matrix (hue and saturation per axis)
00074.evidence: Manual: 16 axes x (Hue, Saturation) = 32 values. Non-zero only in Kodakish files. Probable order: 16 hue values, then 16 saturation values (Kodakish: sat raised on R/R+/YL- = orange) - unverified FS7M2 round 8 (2026-10-09): Hue +10 on axis B- changes position 15 to 3293, Saturation -10 changes position 31 to -3293: positions 0-15 = hue per axis, 16-31 = saturation per axis (axis order of the menu: B, B+, MG-, MG, MG+, R, R+, YL-, YL, YL+, G-, G, G+, CY, CY+, B-). Area Indication and the selected axis are not stored.

widget.note: 32 values: the first 16 are the hue per axis, the last 16 the saturation per axis (order as in the camera menu: B, B+, MG–, MG, MG+, R, R+, YL–, YL, YL+, G–, G, G+, CY, CY+, B–). Area Indication and the selected axis are not stored in the file. ● marks axes with a value.

00085.name: Gamma Select: HG (index HG1-HG8)
00085.evidence: Only ID differing between HG3/HG4 and HG7/HG8 file pairs; 2..5 match the manual's HG list order. Category (STD/HG/User/S-Log2/S-Log3) is a separate, still unidentified ID. sample set A Interviews (STD5 R709) = 4, B-Roll (HG8) = 5, Universal (S-Log3) = 4: index is within the category, so S-Log3 = 4 is not an HG/STD index -> category matters

widget.note: Applies while the gamma category is HG (assignment HG1-HG4, HG7, HG8 = 0-5).

00158.name: Preset White (K) per ND slot (?)
00158.evidence: First value = Preset White in K: Kodakish5600K 4900 (page), sample set C FS7II files all 5600 (daylight preset), sample set B 6000/2800/4900/5700. Mk2 has 6 values = probably Preset White per ND-filter slot (CLEAR/1/2/3 + variable CLEAR/On), only the first is changed in all sample files. Older FS7 files only one value

00144.name: White memory A: R gain, B gain (?)
00144.evidence: Same two values are the first two entries of 00164 in all files (FS7M2: sample set B -7604,750 / sample set C 9227,-21402; FS7: sample set A 8338,-19829). Memory A of Paint > White

00164.name: White memory A: R gain, B gain, colour temp K (?)
00164.evidence: Third value = colour temperature of the stored white (sample set C 5624, sample set B 2872); first two = 00144. 00165 = memory B (sample set B 5625; sample set C unused 0,0,3200). 00166..00181 (0,0,3200) are probably further white memories (per ND slot)

00057.name: Knee Point (x0.001 %) or shutter angle x500 (?)
00057.evidence: Constant 90000: either Knee Point 90 % (manual default 90 %, range 75-109 %) or Shutter Angle 180 deg * 500. ALL files hold 90000 three times (00079, 00085, 00105), constant in custom and Cine EI files, so unresolved

00008.name: Master Black (non-linear scale)
00008.evidence: FS7 Mk1: Master Black -2 -> -1075, -3 -> -1158 (sample sets A and B), -5 -> -1654. Not linear in the menu step (steps of 83 then 248) - scale unknown. FS7M2 differs (-786 for -3) FS7M2 ALL (014/013/012/010): -5 = -1778, -2 = -827, -4 = -1613, -3 = -992 (middle of the step); the older note '-786 for -3' is not confirmed.

00149.name: Kodakish-specific flags
00149.evidence: 1,1,0 only in Kodakish files (page: needs Scene White Data ON)

_transfer._comment: Rules for switching the target camera model. Default: an ID is copied between models if it exists in both with the same number of fields and the value is valid for the target. none = model specific (never copied, values differ systematically between FS7 and FS7M2 or unit unknown); first = only the first field is copied. 2026-10-09: 00002 (Multi Matrix Setting), 00037 (Aperture Setting), 00068/00069 (White Clip) are carried now: their meaning is the same on both cameras.

00008._comment: Master Black: raw wheel value of the same displayed step (-2, -3, -5). Mk1: sample set B/A files; Mk2: FS7M2 013.ALL (-2), 010.ALL (-3), 014.ALL (-5), taken in the middle of the step; -4 on the Mk2 = -1613 (012.ALL). The wheel has finer values than the display, so a step is a range, not one value.

00036.name: Aperture Level
00036.evidence: the author of sample set A FS7 Mk1 files: Aperture Level +30/+20/+9 -> 9880/6586/2964 (= steps * 329.33). FS7 Mk1; FS7M2 files all 0

00037.name: Aperture Setting (On/Off)
00037.evidence: FS7 Mk1: 1 in the three sample set A files (APERTURE ON), 0 in sample set B's files (Aperture OFF). FS7M2: 1 in all sample set B files although the page says Aperture OFF - meaning on FS7M2 unclear, hence model specific. sample set C FS7II: 1 in JR45Video, 0 in the four others -> the flag does vary per look on FS7M2 as well (aperture meaning plausible) FS7M2 round 5 (2026-10-09): Aperture Off changes only 00037 1 -> 0 (Level 9 -> 12 = 2964 -> 3952 in 00036). Equals ALL 00069 (id_map).

widget.note: With Off, the Aperture level is greyed out.

00069.name: White Clip Level (90.0 to 109.0 %, file value x 10)
00069.evidence: 1080 in all sample set A files and FS7M2, 1055 in sample set B's FS7 files; manual: White Clip Level 90.0-109.0 %, default 108.0/105.0 % Manual: 90.0-109.0 %. Values seen: 1055 (sample set B FS7), 1080 (sample set B FS7M2), 1090, 1080 (sample set A).

widget.note: Manual: White Clip level 90.0 % to 109.0 %; the setting (On/Off) returns to On when the camera is switched off, permanently off = level 109 %; not adjustable with gamma category S-Log2/S-Log3 (the camera switches it off there). Rule of thumb: standard gamma 105 %, HyperGamma (HG3/HG4/HG7/HG8) 109 %, otherwise the camera clips the highlights hard; live/broadcast 100 %.

00017.name: Gamma Category (STD / HG / User / S-Log2 / S-Log3)
00017.evidence: STD flag: 1 only in sample set A INTERVIEWS (STD5 R709). 00143 = 1 only in sample set A UNIVERSAL-1 (S-Log3), 00019 = 1 in the HG files. Same block as the ALL file (id_map: 00017 -> 00039, 00019 -> 00041, 00022 -> 00044, 00078 -> 00190, 00143 -> 00494).

widget.label: Category
widget.note: The gamma category consists of five flags (00017 STD, 00019 HG, 00078 User, 00022 S-Log2, 00143 S-Log3; exactly one is 1). Gamma Select has its own IDs per category (00018 STD, 00085 HG); S-Log2/S-Log3 have no sub-selection. The user selection is not yet assigned in the SCENE file.

00060.name: Knee flag (?)
00060.evidence: see 00017. Flags that are 1 only with gamma category STD; the HG-only flags are 00019 and 00043 (also constant 1 in all sample set B files), the S-Log3-only ones are 00143, 00053 (+14) and 00115 (also 1 for STD)

00068.name: White Clip Setting (On/Off)
00068.evidence: Equals ALL 00125 (FS7M2 015.ALL: White Clip Off changes only that ID). Values: 1 in the FS7M2 files and sample set A INTERVIEWS (STD), 0 in the sample set B FS7 files and sample set A B-Roll/Universal.

widget.note: With Off, the White Clip level is greyed out. With S-Log2/S-Log3 the camera switches the setting off.

00145.name: White memory B: R gain, B gain (?)
00145.evidence: Pair copied into 00165; sample set C files have 0,0 (memory B unused), sample set B FS7M2 14692,-14857

00165.name: White memory B: R gain, B gain, colour temp K (?)

00021.name: Step Gamma (0.35 to 0.90, file value x 100)
00021.evidence: Constant 45 in all FS7/FS7M2/sample sets A/C files = Step Gamma 0.45, the manual default (range 0.35-0.90 in 0.05 steps); ALL 00043 holds the same value User (2026-10-08): interpreted as 0.45, range 0.35-0.90 (manual: steps of 0.05).

widget.note: Step Gamma 0.35 to 0.90 in steps of 0.05 (manual), default 0.45. The file holds the value times 100 (45 = 0.45). The buttons change by 0.05 and 0.10.

00002.name: Multi Matrix Setting (On/Off)
00002.evidence: FS7: 1 only in the files with Multi Matrix data (sample set B Kodakish 007/008, Filmlike2 004); 0 in all sample set A files; FS7M2 files all 1. ALL equivalent 00020 FS7M2 round 7 (2026-10-09): Multi Matrix Off changes only 00002 1 -> 0 (round 8: On again). Matrix Off blocks changes of the multi matrix on the camera. Equals ALL 00020 (id_map).

widget.note: With Off, the multi matrix is greyed out. With Matrix Off it cannot be changed on the camera either.

00019.name: HG gamma category flag (?)
00019.evidence: 1 for HG gamma (B-Roll-1 and all sample set B files), 0 for STD (Interviews) and S-Log3 (Universal); 00043 behaves identically. Possibly part of the gamma category / HG related items. Part of a one-hot gamma category: 00019 = HG, 00022 = S-Log2, 00143 = S-Log3 (STD probably 00017)

00043.name: Detail Level Depend (On/Off)
00043.evidence: FS7M2 round 2 (2026-10-09): Level Depend Off -> On: scene 00043 0 -> 1 (ALL 00087). Earlier taken for an HG-only flag.

widget.note: With Off, Level Depend Level is greyed out.

00143.name: S-Log3 gamma category flag (?)
00143.evidence: 1 only in sample set A Universal-1 (S-Log3); possibly part of the gamma category. One-hot gamma category with 00019 (HG) and 00022 (S-Log2) Pairs: Mk1 003.SCENE (S-Log3) / 003.ALL have 00143 = 1 / 00494 = 1, 004.SCENE (HG8) / 004.ALL 0 / 0.

00053.name: Detail Frequency (menu step -99..+99)
00053.evidence: FS7M2 round 2 (2026-10-09): Detail Frequency -> 4940 (+15 steps x 329.33) in the pair 001.SCENE/001.ALL vs round 1.

00022.name: S-Log2 gamma category flag (?)
00022.evidence: ALL equivalent 00044 flips to 1 only when the colour space is S-Gamut/SLog2 (011.ALL); constant 0 in all SCENE files (none uses S-Log2). Together with 00019 (HG) and 00143 (S-Log3) a one-hot gamma category

00018.name: Gamma Select: STD (index STD1-STD6)
00018.evidence: Maps to ALL 00040 (STD select, FS7M2 006.ALL: STD5 -> STD2 changes only that ID). 4 (= STD5) in all SCENE files.

widget.note: Applies while the gamma category is STD.

00023.name: Gamma (On/Off)
00023.evidence: Maps to ALL 00045 (FS7M2 008.ALL: Gamma Off changes only that ID); 1 in all SCENE files.

widget.note: With Off, all other gamma settings are greyed out.

00024.name: Master Gamma (menu step -99..+99)
00024.evidence: Maps to ALL 00046 (FS7M2 009.ALL: Master Gamma -10 = -3293); 0 in all SCENE files.

00078.name: Gamma category flag: User (?)
00078.evidence: Maps to ALL 00190 (FS7M2 007.ALL: User/User4); 0 in all SCENE files.

00010.name: Black Setting (On/Off)
00010.evidence: Equals ALL 00031 (id_map; ALL 00031: 0 = On, 1 = Off, confirmed with FS7M2 011.ALL). Value 0 in all 58 SCENE files, so the pairing is not yet verified by a changed value.

widget.note: With Off, the other black settings are greyed out (as in the ALL file). The mapping to scene ID 00010 is not yet confirmed by a changed value.

00009.name: B Black (menu step -99..+99)
00009.evidence: Equals ALL 00030 (id_map; FS7M2 012.ALL: B Black +25 = 8254, scale 330.16 per step). Value 0 in all 58 SCENE files, pairing not yet verified by a changed value.

00005.name: Matrix Setting (On/Off)
00005.evidence: FS7M2 round 6 (2026-10-09): Matrix Off changes only scene 00005 1 -> 0 (the other file type: ALL 00023). Cine EI also sets it to 0. Equals ALL 00023 (id_map; ALL 00023 is 1 in Custom, 0 in Cine EI). Value 1 in all 58 SCENE files.

widget.note: With Off, Preset Matrix and User Matrix are greyed out (Multi Matrix has its own switch).

00044.name: Detail Setting (On/Off)
00044.evidence: FS7M2 round 1 (2026-10-09): Detail Setting Off -> On changes only scene 00044 0 -> 1 (and ALL 00088 0 -> 1, same pair).

widget.note: With Off, the other detail settings are greyed out (an assumption, as with gamma, black and white clip).

00045.name: Detail Level (menu step -99..+99)
00045.evidence: FS7M2 round 2 (2026-10-09): Detail Level -> 329 (+1 steps x 329.33) in the pair 001.SCENE/001.ALL vs round 1.

00046.name: Detail H/V Ratio (menu step -99..+99)
00046.evidence: FS7M2 round 2 (2026-10-09): Detail H/V Ratio -> 659 (+2 steps x 329.33) in the pair 001.SCENE/001.ALL vs round 1.

00047.name: Detail Crispening (menu step -99..+99)
00047.evidence: FS7M2 round 2 (2026-10-09): Detail Crispening -> 988 (+3 steps x 329.33) in the pair 001.SCENE/001.ALL vs round 1.

00042.name: Detail Level Depend Level (menu step -99..+99)
00042.evidence: FS7M2 round 2 (2026-10-09): Detail Level Depend Level -> -329 (-1 steps x 329.33) in the pair 001.SCENE/001.ALL vs round 1.

00049.name: Detail Knee Aperture (On/Off)
00049.evidence: FS7M2 round 3 (2026-10-09): Detail Knee Aperture (On/Off) Off -> On = 1 (pair 001.SCENE/001.ALL vs round 2).

widget.note: With Off, Knee Aperture Level is greyed out.

00048.name: Detail Knee Aperture Level
00048.evidence: FS7M2 round 3 (2026-10-09): Detail Knee Aperture Level +5 = 1647 (pair 001.SCENE/001.ALL vs round 2).

00052.name: Detail Limit
00052.evidence: FS7M2 round 3 (2026-10-09): Detail Limit -5 = -1647 (pair 001.SCENE/001.ALL vs round 2).

00050.name: Detail White Limit
00050.evidence: FS7M2 round 3 (2026-10-09): Detail White Limit +10 = 3293 (pair 001.SCENE/001.ALL vs round 2).

00051.name: Detail Black Limit
00051.evidence: FS7M2 round 3 (2026-10-09): Detail Black Limit -10 = -3293 (pair 001.SCENE/001.ALL vs round 2).

00054.name: Detail V Black Limit
00054.evidence: FS7M2 round 3 (2026-10-09): Detail V Black Limit +15 = 4940 (pair 001.SCENE/001.ALL vs round 2).

00055.name: Detail V Detail Creation
00055.evidence: FS7M2 round 3 (2026-10-09): Detail V Detail Creation Y -> NAM = 3 -> 0 (pair 001.SCENE/001.ALL vs round 2). Round 4: V Detail Creation G = 1.

widget.note: NAM = 0, G = 1 (FS7M2 round 4), Y = 3 (round 3); G+R is therefore probably 2.

00025.name: Skin Detail (Setting, Level, Saturation, Hue, Width)

widget.note: Skin Detail: level and saturation -99 to +99 (329.33 per step), hue 0 to 359 degrees (stored as -degrees x 182.04, the colour next to it), width 0 to 90 (degrees x 182.04).

00115.name: Adaptive Matrix (On/Off)
00115.evidence: FS7M2 round 9 (2026-10-09): Adaptive Matrix On -> Off changes only scene 00115 1 -> 0 (and ALL 00307 in the other file type). Equals ALL 00307 (id_map).

widget.note: Cannot be changed with Matrix Off (assumed like the other matrix items).
